title: PitayaGradeData
description: Root schema for the PitayaGrade dragon fruit quality grading and disease detection system. Organizes scan records, grade classifications, and disease detections for efficient pre-harvest assessment.

scanList.description: Collection of all scan assessment records performed on dragon fruit samples.

gradeList.description: Collection of quality grade classification results from the EfficientNet-B3 compound grading model.

diseaseList.description: Collection of disease detection results from the YOLOv8-Seg segmentation model.

ScanResult.description: Represents a single dragon fruit scan assessment record containing grade, disease, and physical attribute data.

scanID.description: Unique identifier for the scan record.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the scan was performed.

imagePath.description: File path or URI to the captured dragon fruit image.

gradeLabel.description: Quality grade classification assigned by the EfficientNet-B3 model.

gradeConfidence.description: Confidence score (0.0 to 1.0) of the grade classification.

diseaseName.description: Detected disease or health status from YOLOv8-Seg segmentation.

diseaseConfidence.description: Confidence score (0.0 to 1.0) of the disease classification.

size.description: Estimated size category based on ROI coverage analysis.

surfaceCondition.description: Surface condition determined by edge density analysis.

processingMode.description: Inference mode used for processing the scan.

notes.description: Optional user-added notes for the scan record.

GradeResult.description: Represents the quality grade classification output from the EfficientNet-B3 compound scoring model.

gradeID.description: Unique identifier for the grade record.

confidence.description: Model confidence score for the grade classification.

colorUniformity.description: Percentage of color uniformity across the fruit surface (e.g. '85.3%').

colorDescriptor.description: Dominant color descriptor based on hue analysis.

compoundScore.description: Weighted compound quality score from 6 feature dimensions (color uniformity, maturity, size, smoothness, symmetry, brightness).

recommendations.description: Actionable harvest and handling recommendations based on the grade.

DiseaseResult.description: Represents the disease detection output from the YOLOv8-Seg per-pixel segmentation model.

diseaseID.description: Unique identifier for the disease detection record.

diseaseName.description: Detected disease name or healthy status.

confidence.description: Model confidence score for the disease classification.

isHealthy.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the fruit is disease-free.

areaPercent.description: Percentage of fruit surface area affected by the detected disease.

symptoms.description: List of visual symptoms detected on the fruit surface.

managementTips.description: Recommended management and treatment actions for the detected disease.
